data.name: Avanija
data.long_meaning: Avanija is a Sanskrit name which is derived from the word 'Ava' meaning 'East' and 'Ni' meaning 'Goddess'. This name signifies the Goddess of the East. It is believed that the Goddess of the East brings prosperity and good fortune to one's life.

historical_references.reference: Avanija was a celebrated courtesan in the ancient Indian city of Vidisha, in the 6th century CE. She is known for her beauty, intelligence, and wit that attracted the attention of many rulers and poets.

historical_references.reference: Avanija was the central figure in the 18th century Indian literary work 'Amarusataka' by the poet King Amarasimha of Kashmir. The work is a collection of poems extolling the virtues of Avanija and her beauty that is compared to the blooming lotus flower.
